questions.prompt: Do you prefer to sit by the window when travelling?

answers.basic: Yes, especially on a train. I like watching the view change outside, and it gives me a reason to put my phone away for a while. On the train back to Hunan, I especially like seeing the buildings give way to fields as we leave the city.

questions.prompt: Did you have a long journey with your family as a child?

answers.basic: Yes, I remember taking a long train journey from Hunan with my family. I spent most of it looking out of the window and asking how much longer we had. It felt like a big adventure because I'd never been on a train long enough to eat more than one meal there.
